body: MLS retained plaintext now lives in App Support/vibe-secure/retained.v1 sealed with the core store key (AES-GCM); legacy UserDefaults vibe.mls.ownPlaintext is migrated then removed. Peer rows whose envelope epoch <= group epoch with no pending commit are tombstoned (unrecoverable set) and never retried; builder renders a resend hint for own/tombstoned rows.
author: Vibe Team
